units.source_text: 催马乐《席田》歌：“席田呀席田，川上有仙鹤。

en.t: The saibara song Shida says: Shida, Shida, there are sacred cranes upriver.

units.source_text: 仙鹤寿千龄，川上恣游乐。

en.t: The sacred cranes live for a thousand years, roaming and playing freely upriver.

units.source_text: 仙鹤寿万代，川上戏相逐。”

en.t: The sacred cranes live for ten thousand generations, frolicking and chasing one another upriver.

units.source_text: 席田是美浓郡的名胜地。

en.t: Shida is a famous scenic place in Mino District.
